label: Update gate dips after a1 trials (a1 S1 at D2, a1 S2 at D1) and when S1 is believed good.
terms: belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 2) * ep_trial ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (action == 1) * ep_trial
explanation: Raw z of unit 16 sits near 0.98-0.99 and dips (less retention) in an a1-associated way. Largest dips: at D2 when the agent just chose a1 and reached S1 (common a1 transition, about -0.018), and at D1 after a previous a1 trial that reached S2 (rare, about -0.021), regardless of reward. On top, a graded term in the ideal-observer belief: the more S1 is believed good (belief_lo high), the lower z, in every phase and strongest at D2. Reward of the last trial matters little. The free fit adds a stronger belief slope at D2, a GO-phase dip after a previous a1 choice, and a deepening of the a1 dips late in the episode (the timing baseline drops late and the a1 dips grow with ep_trial); these lift dev R^2 from 0.56 to 0.63. All terms are observed (action and state at D2 are already seen).

issues: Short form reproduces: test R^2 beyond timing 0.544. Removing parts costs: belief_lo -0.10 (0.441), D2 a1-S1 term -0.08 (0.461), D1 prev a1-S2 term -0.08 (0.463). Each term matters.

The D2 dip is specific to a1 reaching S1. (phase==D2)*(action==1) alone scores 0.482 and (phase==D2)*(state==1) alone scores 0.469, both below 0.544. The profile agrees: D2 residual is -0.019 for a1 S1, -0.001 for a1 S2, +0.007 for a2 S1 and +0.014 for a2 S2.

The 'reward makes little difference' claim holds at D1: after a1 S2 r the residual is -0.026, after a1 S2 u it is -0.021. But at D2, the residual after a previous a1 S2 trial depends strongly on that trial's reward (r +0.006, u -0.024). That is the largest remaining miss class (D2 after a1 S2 r under-predicted by +0.011, after a1 S2 u over-predicted by -0.009). The miss is modest compared with the main dips.
The belief slope is weakest at D1. Dropping belief_lo at D1, i.e. belief_lo*(phase != D1), raises test R^2 to 0.561. So 'in every phase' overstates it a little.

The worst-fit windows are all late in the episode (t92-99), where a1 dips reach z ~0.83-0.87 against predicted ~0.93. This matches the free fit's ep_trial interactions. Adding ep_trial to the a1 terms inside the short-form limits did not help on test (0.536-0.541).

The label calls both dips 'after a1 trials'. At D2 the dip is on the current trial: the a1 choice has just reached S1, the common transition. The D1 dip follows a previous a1 trial that ended in S2, the rare transition. The wording could be sharper, but the content matches the short form.

Checked that belief (instead of belief_lo) gives 0.545, essentially the same. There is no future-variable use, and the short form is not curve fitting: every term is a readable observed event or belief.
